1	"""Grade an answer text against validated expected values."""
2	
3	import re
4	from typing import Any
5	
6	from evidence.accuracy.matcher import normalise
7	from evidence.answer.schema import SCHEMA_VERSION, load_expected
8	
9	_WORD = "A-Za-z0-9_"
10	_NUMBER_BEFORE = rf"(?<![{_WORD}])(?<![0-9][.,])"
11	_NUMBER_AFTER = rf"(?![{_WORD}])(?![.,][0-9])"
12	# A minus sign glued to the token makes it a different (negative) number,
13	# unless the sign is a range dash after a word character ("3-5").
14	_NOT_NEGATED = rf"(?:(?<!-)|(?<=[{_WORD}]-))"
15	_IDENT_BEFORE = rf"(?<![{_WORD}./-])"
16	_IDENT_AFTER = rf"(?![{_WORD}/-])(?!\.[{_WORD}])"
17	
18	
19	def _token_pattern(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
20	    text = re.escape(item["text"])
21	    if item["kind"] == "number":
22	        sign = "" if item["text"].startswith("-") else _NOT_NEGATED
23	        return f"{_NUMBER_BEFORE}{sign}{text}{_NUMBER_AFTER}"
24	    return f"{_IDENT_BEFORE}{text}{_IDENT_AFTER}"
25	
26	
27	def _present(item: dict[str, Any], answer: str) -> bool:
28	    if item["kind"] == "text":
29	        needle = normalise(item["text"])
30	        if item.get("fold_case", False):
31	            return needle.casefold() in answer.casefold()
32	        return needle in answer
33	    return re.search(_token_pattern(item), answer, re.ASCII) is not None
34	
35	
36	def _result(verdict: str, found, missing, forbidden, cause=None) -> dict[str, Any]:
37	    return {
38	        "verdict": verdict,
39	        "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
40	        "found": found,
41	        "missing": missing,
42	        "forbidden_present": forbidden,
43	        "cause": cause,
44	    }
45	
46	
47	def _check_groups(groups, answer: str, found: list, missing: list) -> None:
48	    for group in groups:
49	        hit = next((item for item in group if _present(item, answer)), None)
50	        if hit is None:
51	            missing.append({"one_of": group})
52	        else:
53	            found.append(hit)
54	
55	
56	def grade(answer_text: str, expected: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
57	    """Grade ``answer_text`` against ``expected``; see the package docstring."""
58	    exp = load_expected(expected)
59	    answer = normalise(answer_text)
60	    if not any((exp["must_appear"], exp["must_not_appear"], exp["one_of"])):
61	        return _result("cannot_tell", [], [], [], "no_expected_items")
62	    if not answer:
63	        return _result("cannot_tell", [], [], [], "empty_answer")
64	    found = [i for i in exp["must_appear"] if _present(i, answer)]
65	    missing = [i for i in exp["must_appear"] if i not in found]
66	    _check_groups(exp["one_of"], answer, found, missing)
67	    forbidden = [i for i in exp["must_not_appear"] if _present(i, answer)]
68	    verdict = "does_not_match" if missing or forbidden else "matches"
69	    return _result(verdict, found, missing, forbidden)

1	"""Answer check library: grade an answer text against a task's expected values.
2	
3	Nothing here reads an export or calls a model; it is a pure function of two
4	inputs and uses only the standard library and ``evidence``.
5	
6	Expected values (JSON object, ``schema_version`` 1; the schema ships as
7	``evidence/data/expected_values.schema.json``)::
8	
9	    {
10	      "schema_version": 1,              # required, must equal SCHEMA_VERSION
11	      "must_appear":     [item, ...],   # every one must be in the answer
12	      "must_not_appear": [item, ...],   # none may be in the answer
13	      "one_of": [[item, ...], ...]      # per group, at least one must appear
14	    }                                   # the three lists are optional
15	
16	    item = {"text": str,                # non-empty
17	            "kind": "number" | "identifier" | "text",
18	            "fold_case": bool}          # optional, "text" items only
19	
20	Any other key, at any level, is refused. Matching, after
21	``evidence.accuracy.matcher.normalise`` has collapsed whitespace in the answer:
22	
23	* ``text``: substring; ``fold_case`` compares case-insensitively.
24	* ``number`` (``-?digits`` with optional ``.``/``,`` groups): a whole token, so
25	  ``9`` is not in ``19``, ``0.5`` not in ``10.5``, ``1.2`` and ``2.3`` not in
26	  ``1.2.3``. Currency signs, ``%``, brackets, commas and a sentence-ending
27	  full stop may touch it. ``5`` does not match inside ``-5``. ASCII digits only.
28	* ``identifier`` (no whitespace; dots, underscores, dashes, slashes allowed): a
29	  whole token, so ``check_quote`` is not in ``check_quote_all`` and
30	  ``lib/facts.ts`` is not in ``src/lib/facts.ts`` or ``lib/facts.ts.bak``.
31	
32	``grade(answer_text, expected)`` returns a JSON-serialisable dict:
33	
34	* ``verdict``: ``"matches"``, ``"does_not_match"`` or ``"cannot_tell"``
35	* ``schema_version``: the schema version graded under
36	* ``found``: items (as given) that were required and present, plus, for each
37	  satisfied group, the alternative that was found
38	* ``missing``: required items absent, and for an unsatisfied group
39	  ``{"one_of": [items]}``
40	* ``forbidden_present``: ``must_not_appear`` items that are in the answer
41	* ``cause``: ``None``, or for ``cannot_tell`` ``"empty_answer"`` or
42	  ``"no_expected_items"``
43	
44	``cannot_tell`` happens only for an empty (blank) answer or expected values
45	naming no item; its three lists are empty. Invalid expected values raise
46	``ExpectedValuesError`` (a ``ValueError``) whose message is the reason.
47	``load_expected(data)`` validates without grading.
48	"""
49	
50	from evidence.answer.grade import grade
51	from evidence.answer.schema import SCHEMA_VERSION, ExpectedValuesError, load_expected
52	
53	__all__ = ["SCHEMA_VERSION", "ExpectedValuesError", "grade", "load_expected"]
